# sherpa-tooltip

A hover/focus tooltip wrapping a trigger.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Category | container |
| Figma | Tooltip (atom) |
| Source | [.ts](../../src/components/sherpa-tooltip/sherpa-tooltip.ts) · [.html](../../src/components/sherpa-tooltip/sherpa-tooltip.html) · [.css](../../src/components/sherpa-tooltip/sherpa-tooltip.css) · [.component.json](../../src/components/sherpa-tooltip/sherpa-tooltip.component.json) · [.example.json](../../src/components/sherpa-tooltip/sherpa-tooltip.example.json) |

## Example

```html
<sherpa-tooltip data-text="Delete this item"><sherpa-button data-type="icon" data-icon-start="trash" aria-label="Delete"></sherpa-button></sherpa-tooltip>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data-anchor` | text |  | a selector for the box it describes, when it does not wrap one |
| `data-placement` | `top` `bottom` `left` `right` | `top` | top \| bottom \| left \| right |
| `data-text` | text |  | tip text (or use the `tip` slot) |

## Properties

| Property | Type | Access | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | `string` | read and write |  |

## Slots

| Slot | Accepts | What it holds |
|---|---|---|
| (default) | content | the trigger element the tooltip describes |
| `tip` | content | rich tip content (reflects has-tip; overrides data-text) |

## Parts

Style these from outside with `::part()`:

`anchor`, `arrow`, `bubble`
